scope: Select practical defaults within the declared model/effort and candidate-budget search space, not a global optimum over all possible parameters.
deadlinePolicy: Keep completed results and explicitly mark cancelled or unstarted work. Do not invent scores or declare an uncompleted validation successful.

phase1.purpose: Measure data-split and independent-generation variability for all 26 registered model/effort combinations

shortlist.ranking: Equal-weight mean of per-seed completed-run fitness; select best eligible effort per model, then the top two model families. If none meets reliability threshold, rank completion first and disclose this outcome.

phase2.purpose: Compare candidate budget, batch granularity and deterministic handling of excess proposals at the same 30-assay budget

selection.rule: Among eligible profiles within 5% of the best equal-weight per-seed mean fitness, choose lowest median reported total tokens, then lowest median wall time. Missing usage cannot win a token comparison.

phase3.purpose: Independent confirmation of selected defaults against a fixed reference

bootstrap.innerUnit: independent trajectory within model and split

phase3.applyRule: Prefer a profile meeting the completion target; compare quality within the declared 5% practical band and then token/time use. If neither profile meets the target, apply the more reliable measured profile as provisional and disclose the unmet reliability target.

controls: Each repetition starts from initial training data and has unique run and operation identifiers; saved responses are not replayed into a new repetition.
Model-training randomness follows the fixed data seed unless explicitly recorded otherwise; LLM sampling seeds are not invented for providers that do not expose them.
The final held-out test labels never enter selection, candidate design or default tuning.
Failures and partial trajectories remain in the records; completion rate and conditional quality are reported separately.
Round checkpoints on one trajectory are dependent and are not treated as independent repetitions.
Unknown model-request outcomes are not automatically resubmitted.
Temperature and prompt/knowledge/context settings remain fixed within each phase.
Predictor candidate grids and data sizes are controlled settings, not claimed to be globally optimized by this study.
